meta.description: Bellavere manages luxury villas and apartments across Mauritius — rentals, maintenance, client care and concierge, with a live dashboard for every owner.

hero.intro: We look after villas, apartments and residences all around Mauritius — no hidden fees, always a real person to answer you, and a live dashboard that shows exactly how your property is performing.

services.title: Everything your property needs, under one roof
services.sub: One team, no hidden fees, and a real person at the end of the line — so owning property in Mauritius stays a pleasure.

items.rental: From listing, marketing and pricing to enquiries, bookings and guest check-ins, we run your rental end to end.
items.maintenance: Preventive care, repairs and regular inspections keep your property in good order year-round. Every job is logged and its status is visible on your dashboard.
items.clientCare: One contact knows your property, your preferences and your guests by name — and a real person always answers. Clear statements arrive monthly.
items.concierge: Airport transfers, welcome packs, housekeeping and guest services — the extras that make a stay memorable and lift your rental yield.

syndic.title: Syndic & residence management
syndic.copy: Common areas, pools and gardens, preventive maintenance, contractor supervision and clear owner reporting — one reliable point of contact for every co-owner.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to an effortless property

onboard.title: Onboard
onboard.copy: We meet you, inspect your property, agree your fee and set up your listing — onboarding takes one to two weeks.

manage.title: We manage
manage.copy: Guests welcomed, upkeep handled, statements prepared — one team runs the whole operation.

grow.title: You watch it grow
grow.copy: Occupancy, revenue and maintenance, live on your owner dashboard — from Paris, London or the beach house next door.

dashboardTeaser.title: Your portfolio, live
dashboardTeaser.sub: No more waiting for the end-of-season phone call. Your dashboard shows how your property is performing, the moment anything changes.

bullets.live: Real-time occupancy and revenue, updated with every booking
bullets.calendar: Bookings and the guest calendar at a glance
bullets.maintenance: Maintenance status, from first report to resolution
bullets.statements: Monthly statements, itemised and ready to download

dashboardTeaser.ownFiguresOnly: Every owner sees only their own properties — your figures stay yours, and yours alone.

dashboardPreview.label: Preview of the Bellavere owner dashboard showing live revenue, occupancy and bookings

elise.quote: I live abroad and my villa is on the north coast, yet I always know exactly how it is doing. And when I call, a real person answers — every time.
elise.name: Élise M.

deepak.quote: No surprise charges. Every repair is on the statement with a line explaining it, and the fee was agreed face to face before we started.
deepak.name: Deepak R.

nathalie.quote: As a residence we needed one reliable contact for the pool, the gardens and the contractors. That is exactly what we got.
nathalie.name: Nathalie C.

ctaBand.title: Let your island home work beautifully
ctaBand.sub: Tell us about your property and we'll show you, openly, what it could achieve.
